name: charter-kit
description: A lightweight, host-neutral development charter that can bootstrap a project from zero.

interface.shortDescription: Portable project charter and leaf-task workflow
interface.longDescription: Start a project with a guided intent interview, then use one charter, task contract, evidence record, and handoff packet across agents and hosts. Optional providers enhance the workflow but are never required.
defaultPrompt: Start a new project with an intent interview.
